items.title: Hitler's Eagle's Nest burns down in a suspected arson
items.summary: The Kehlsteinhaus, the 1938 mountaintop retreat built for Hitler above Berchtesgaden and now a tourist restaurant and museum, caught fire Friday night and was left a charred shell on a snowy peak by Saturday after about 200 firefighters fought it through a storm. Police stopped a 33-year-old German on a red motorcycle with no plates; prosecutors said he showed signs of mental illness and that a political motive was also being examined. Webcam shots of the house glowing on the ridge spread across X (8.7K likes on the biggest post), the Wikipedia article drew 110K views, and the replies ran to Band of Brothers references and jokes that Hitler wasn't home. Bavaria said it would not leave a ruin there.
